# cosmo_router_token (Resource)

Generates a token that is limited to a federated graph. This token allows the router to interact with the platform and send metrics to the collectors.

For more information on router tokens, please refer to the [Cosmo Documentation](https://cosmo-docs.wundergraph.com/cli/router/token/create).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cosmo_router_token" "test" {
  name       = var.name
  graph_name = var.graph_name
  namespace  = var.namespace
}
```

## Recreating the token when its federated graph is recreated

Changing `name`, `graph_name` or `namespace` always deletes the token and creates a new one. If
`graph_name` and `namespace` refer to the graph, as in the example below, renaming the graph or moving it
to another namespace therefore also recreates the token.

When Cosmo deletes a federated graph, it also deletes the graph's router tokens. If you force Terraform to
recreate the graph with the same name and namespace, for example with
`terraform apply -replace=cosmo_federated_graph.this` or `terraform taint`, none of the token's settings
change, so Terraform leaves the token alone in that apply. The token is then missing in Cosmo, and anything
using its `token` value has an invalid token. The next `terraform apply` notices this and creates a new
token.

To create the new token in the same apply, tell Terraform to replace the token whenever the graph is
replaced, using `replace_triggered_by`:

```terraform
resource "cosmo_router_token" "this" {
  name       = "router-token"
  graph_name = cosmo_federated_graph.this.name
  namespace  = cosmo_federated_graph.this.namespace

  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [cosmo_federated_graph.this.id]
  }
}
```

A recreated graph gets a new `id`, which triggers the replacement. For a monograph, use
`cosmo_monograph.this.id` instead.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph_name` (String) The name of the graph to create the token for.
- `name` (String) The name of the router token.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) The namespace to create the token in.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the router token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token to be used for the router.
